comment: The public configuration-key list. 'sections' is the set of ConfigurationSectionName/SectionName/SectionPath constants in src/**/*.cs; ./proto docs check compares this array with the source on every run and fails on drift, so update it with the constant. 'allowedKeys' are documented keys that are not section constants, each with its reason and each required to stay mentioned in a docs page. The gate cross-checks every ProtoTest:* key a docs page names against these two lists, which is the half that runs in CI; the private docs-facts sheets add the fact-sheet-to-docs direction where the records checkout exists.

allowedKeys.reason: the integration-owned selection key ProtoTest.Aspire's chain providers read; set by the run script, not an options section
the per-resource selection key ProtoTest.Aspire's chain providers read; the resource name is the identity the AppHost registered it under and the run script sets the key, not an options section
a property of the root ProtoTest section (ProtoCleanupOptions binds from "ProtoTest"), not its own section constant
named in the docs and the fact sheet only to say ProtoTest.Data has no configuration section
the demo's environment switch; sample-side, not a package option
the per-client port address a serial client without an address reads; the client name is its registration name, not an options section
the shared default section of the HTTP attachment options when a protocol names none
the shared default section of the HTTP response options when a protocol names none
the Northstar sample's opt-in switch read by FailureDrills.RequireDrills; sample-side, not a package option
the demo's published-target switch; sample-side, not a package option
the sample application's test-support convention, documented as sample-side
retired in 1.1; the changelog and the migration page name it to say the settings no longer configure sessions
